description: This file provides an implementation of safe string formatting functions, specifically a custom `git_vsnprintf` function with buffer size adjustments for Windows compatibility, and a wrapper `git_snprintf`. It manages buffer sizing and termination to ensure safe string operations within the Git codebase.
